standouts.head: Quiet selling on the dip
standouts.text: Volume on the current pullback runs 26% below its 50-day average: profit-taking, not an exit.
standouts.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.

against.head: Uptrend structure broken, then reclaimed
against.text: On Oct 26 it closed under the Oct 19 higher low, ending the run of higher lows, and it has closed back over that low since; the larger swings (4 ATR) are intact.
against.learn: An uptrend steps up in higher highs and higher lows; a lower high is the first warning, and losing the last higher low breaks it.

material.head: Weekly: wave 4 turning up from its zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Feb 12 to Aug 20 (+63%; wave 3 is 1.6 times wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (−7.9% to −12%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Oct 23, 2023 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−11%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: Back above its averages
material.text: Price has climbed back above both its 50-day and 200-day averages.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Holding its rising 20-day
material.text: It dipped to its rising 20-day average in the last three sessions and held above it.
